It also describes financing coverage running 'from angel and seed investments to structured debt and equity solutions,' across venture and growth capital hubs, and says it represents both startups and VC investors. missing for 10: explicit mention of priced equity rounds by series (Series A through late-stage/growth), named representative transactions, independent corroboration of deal volume.
